ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity (white) to 60% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A large contiguous high-intensity white field dominates the left lobe from the center to the distal edge. The right lobe is predominantly low-intensity black with small high-intensity white clusters concentrated at the distal tip and along the lower trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 35-40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-8 pixels) along the continuous linear boundary; right lobe tip exhibits larger, irregular jagged valleys compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the median notch extending to convex distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: White circular pixel clusters visible at the distal tip of the right lobe and scattered along the inferior trailing edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple parallel, low-intensity vertical and diagonal linear disruptions (rake marks) localized on the right lobe and crossing the lower-center of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation and jagged contour at the distal tip of the right lobe; extensive parallel vertical rake-mark scarring visible across the dark field of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique complex dark pigmentation motif within the high-intensity white field of the left lobe, resembling a series of interconnected linear brushstrokes.
